default/31594.htm.text: Chief Inspector Mond: Hmm... I don't see anything amiss... Next accounting book please! What's taking so long? Hurry up! Dammit...! At this rate, I won't finish even if I work all night! Ah, a customer? I'm sorry. We're conducting an audit and this place is a madhouse! Thank you for your patience.

Q00099_SagaOfTheFortuneSeeker/0-04.htm.text: Chief Inspector Mond: Go to Goddard Castle Town and speak with Pamela Aprodia . She'll tell you more about the tablets. Hurry! The secrets of the tablets must never be handed over to the Benandantis!

Q00099_SagaOfTheFortuneSeeker/0-06.htm.text: Chief Inspector Mond: Ha, ha, ha! Welcome back! You've cut members of the Benedictine Cartel out and beautifully finished your job!

Q00099_SagaOfTheFortuneSeeker/0-09.htm.text: Chief Inspector Mond: You've drunk from the Grail of Splendor and learned the ultimate absolute geometry! You've acheived the sacred knowledge!
